feeds.name: cz_czptt
feeds.title: Czech rail timetable (CZPTT via JrUtil / obehy.cz)
feeds.attribution: Správa železnic (CZPTT open data), converted by the Oběhy project

fare.note: One seat Praha → Hamburg on the ComfortJet, then ICE or metronom for 30 min. Reservations are cheap and trains fill up.

corridors.name: Leipzig → Hannover
corridors.via: Děčín · Bad Schandau · Dresden · Leipzig · Magdeburg · Hannover

fare.note: The western route via Leipzig and Magdeburg, then Hannover–Lüneburg. A fallback when Berlin–Hamburg is disrupted or sold out.
Praha → Plzeň → Furth im Wald (through train), regional to Nürnberg, then the direct ICE to Lüneburg. Avoids Berlin entirely.

corridors.name: Berlin → Büchen
corridors.via: Děčín · Bad Schandau · Dresden · Leipzig · Berlin · Büchen

fare.note: No fare estimate for this corridor yet.

corridors.name: Magdeburg → Uelzen (regional)
corridors.via: Ústí nad Labem · Děčín · Schöna · Dresden · Leipzig · Magdeburg · Stendal · Uelzen

fare.note: German legs are all regional trains, so an existing Deutschlandticket covers them. The Czech part needs its own ticket (cd.cz).

fare_footnote: BahnCard 25 takes 25% (BahnCard 50: 50% on Flexpreis, 25% on Sparpreis) off the German share only; the Czech share is full price. Flexpreis figures are estimates for a through ticket in 2nd class. Czech fares at cd.cz can be cheaper for the same train.
